locations.title: Fosley
locations.description: **Solution:** ||Wait for him to throw one of his minions at you, then bait them into a trapdoor which will fling them at Fosley. Repeat this three times.||

locations.title: Baron Dante
locations.description:
**Solution:** ||

- **Phase 1**: Avoid his shockwave attacks by jumping, then run in and tail swipe him in the face while he's crying. Repeat this three times, you big meanie.
- **Phase 2**: Dodge out of the way as he charges into the wall, then while he's hurt go and tail swipe him in the face. Repeat this three times. Again, quite mean.
- **Phase 3**: Run in circles to avoid his lightning zaps, then run up and tail swipe him in the face after he lands. Repeat this three times.||
